# S12 — Consecutor app icon (adaptive and themed; FLOSS-licensed)

**Findings:** res/drawable/ic_launcher_foreground.xml (template); branding/LICENSE reserves all marks · **Size:** M · **Tree:** release

**2026-10-03** — Owner approved the preview: a horizontal chain of three overlapping rounded-square rings, teal #6ee7d2 on #0f1419. Each link is a ring so the three marks stay distinct. The notification glyph is the same chain in white on a 24dp canvas. No Squalor marks.

**Not in this slice:** the 512 px store icon and screenshots (S49) and any use of the Squalor brand marks.

## Why

- The launcher icon is the Android template.
- The owner decided on a new app-specific icon in brand colors, licensed with the app. Squalor marks (RF/seal/SSS) are all-rights-reserved, and using them would trigger F-Droid's NonFreeAssets anti-feature.

## Files

- `app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_launcher_foreground.xml`, `ic_launcher_background.xml`
- New `app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_launcher_monochrome.xml` and `ic_notification.xml`
- `app/src/main/res/mipmap-anydpi/ic_launcher.xml` and `ic_launcher_round.xml`
- The `mipmap-*dpi/*.webp` files (delete them)
- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/ReminderScheduler.kt` (the notification small icon only)
- `README.md` (artwork licence note); `fastlane/.../icon.png` is exported later by S49

## Failing tests

- None.

## Implement

1. Concept: a short chain of linked marks (three connected rounded squares). Use teal `#6ee7d2` on `#0f1419`, with no RF, seal or SSS motifs (those Squalor marks are all-rights-reserved and would trigger F-Droid's NonFreeAssets anti-feature). Propose the concept to the owner with `slicer note S12`. If there is no reply, the three-link chain above is acceptable as the shipped icon; it only needs to be original and licensed with the app.
2. Draw the launcher icon as vectors on the 108dp adaptive canvas: the artwork inside the 66dp safe zone, a solid background drawable, and a `<monochrome>` layer (`ic_launcher_monochrome.xml`, a single-colour version of the foreground) for Android 13 themed icons. The adaptive icon XML is in `mipmap-anydpi` and needs no `-v26` suffix because `minSdk` is 26. Add `<monochrome android:drawable="@drawable/ic_launcher_monochrome"/>` to both `ic_launcher.xml` and `ic_launcher_round.xml`.
3. Delete the raster launcher images in every `mipmap-*dpi` directory. They are unnecessary because every supported API level uses the adaptive icon. Keep the manifest's `@mipmap/ic_launcher` and `@mipmap/ic_launcher_round` references.
4. Create `ic_notification.xml`: a 24dp, single-colour white vector glyph (it can be one link of the chain). In `ReminderScheduler.showNotification` replace `android.R.drawable.ic_popup_reminder` with `R.drawable.ic_notification`.
5. State the artwork licence (MPL-2.0, the same as the app) in `README.md`.

## Check

- The icon renders under the circle, squircle, and themed-icon launcher settings, and in the notification shade.
